title: unexpected override.cfg location on mac
body: ### Tested versions 3.x, 4.x, all afaik ### System information macOS, all ### Issue description As a player, making use of the `override.cfg` is counterintuitive on mac, since the `.app` bundle seems like what the `.exe` would be on windows, but only developers would know that this is not the case. With #113078 specifically this is going to be a larger point of confusion if users want to (or are told to) change project settings for modding, like adding mod loader autoloads. Instead of this ``` . ├── Game.app/ └── override.cfg ``` being the expected "besides .exe" location, it is ``` . └── Game.app/ └── Contents/ └── MacOS/ ├── Game └── override.cfg ``` And most players don't even know the .app bundle is a folder, since it does not look like one and you need to use the context menu "show package contents" to even enter it before the pr mentioned above, we used --script as entrypoint and just generated the override, the user did not need to place it themselves. the mod loader itself already accounts for this confusion by correcting paths for itself and the /mods folder, but Godot does not account for it. ### Steps to reproduce 1. place override.cfg next to .app bundle 2. launch 3. settings not overridden ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) -
